machine.nproc_note: GNU nproc honours OMP_NUM_THREADS, so `nproc` can print 1 on a multi-core host; `nproc_all` is the core count.
machine.thread_env_note: NPROC sizes XLA's CPU intra-op pool (the JAX rows); the BLAS knobs pin OpenBLAS/MKL/OpenMP (the numpy/scipy rows) and do not touch JAX. Two disjoint families; both are recorded on every CPU timing.

arguments.flat_vector: physical vector; instance_from_vector(xp=jnp) inside the trace

protocol.cache_trap_guard: fresh closure + fresh AnalysisPoint per route; jax.clear_caches()
protocol.asserts: log L agreement across routes rtol 1e-10; grads finite and non-zero for every route and streamed instance
protocol.solver: solver=None; FitPositionsSource never invokes a PointSolver
protocol.pytrees: autofit.jax.register_model(model) for both lanes before any trace

phase2b_rule.rule: go if pytree - flat_vector >= 0.05 ms AND >= 15% of the fused forward call
